verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a native CRM integration with HubSpot, Salesforce, or Attio, or any automatic syncing of notes or summaries onto contact or deal records. The only related evidence is the Developer API (notes, transcripts, attendee emails) and outbound webhooks. Those are developer building blocks a team could use to build such a sync, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a sales lead, meeting notes and summaries sync automatically onto the right contact and deal records in my CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio)
